svg.title: Tracked dumper — Beltadúmper
svg.desc: A deep rear tipping body and small front cab ride above one long continuous crawler undercarriage.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-tracked-dumper","label_en":"Tracked dumper","label_is":"Beltadúmper","section":"01","category_en":"Earthmoving and demolition machinery","category_is":"Jarðvinnslu- og niðurrifsvélar","batch":1,"tags":["earthmoving","haulage"],"description":"A deep rear tipping body and small front cab ride above one long continuous crawler undercarriage.","design_note":"The elongated full-length tracks support both cab and load bed, unlike a wheeled dump carrier.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
